<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Harness carries a 45-file / 8,173-line fork of dd (services/dd) plus a 12-file verb layer (acts/dd). dd now ships standalone as @ai-substrate/dd, consumed as github:AI-Substrate/dd#<full-sha> (packs on install, proxy untouched, sha is provenance). This plan makes harness its first consumer: phase 1 takes the dependency and rewires every import with a verified public home; phase 2 runs the round-3 primitive-sufficiency trial that decides upstream OQ-2 and re-implements plan semantics on public primitives (or blocks per ratified D-3 while dd exports the gap); phase 3 drains the fork against harness-main history and deletes it, retires the harness dd verbs, and lands the D-2 documentation riders. The builder flow driving this plan runs on the very code being replaced - each phase boundary re-proves the dogfood loop.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- One dd implementation: harness consumes @ai-substrate/dd and the in-repo fork (services/dd + acts/dd) is deleted
- Dependency pinned as github:AI-Substrate/dd#<full-40-char-sha>; the 1-week-delayed npm proxy is never on the consume path; re-pin against dd branch shas is the ratified iteration mechanism
- Plan semantics preserved: the round-3 primitive-sufficiency trial decides upstream OQ-2 honestly (dated prediction, per-primitive falsifiers), with the existing test estate green throughout
- harness dd * verbs retired; standalone dd CLI documented in AGENTS.md (install included) and docs/how; harness doctor warns when it is missing
- Dogfood proof AND remediation (Jordan 2026-08-09): defects found in the dd implementation or builder flow while driving this plan are OURS to fix to a working solution - in harness, or in dd via the crab channel + re-pin - never left as silent workarounds
- The builder flow and plan validate driving THIS plan keep working on the rewired build at every phase boundary

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- #119 (harness builder/* schema distribution to consuming repos) - collides with this plan by file only; sequenced behind it

- Porting acts/dd verb UX into the standalone dd CLI (dd already ships its own verb surface)
- fr-0002, fr-0006, fr-0007 (prime holds them unstaffed behind this plan)

<a id="implementation-summary"></a>

## Implementation Summary

Three phases, staged so the irreversible half rides on proven ground. Phase 1 repeats the demonstrated round-2 rewire at the current pin for all four surviving consumers (public-home symbols only) and proves the dogfood loop still drives this plan. Phase 2 is the deciding round for upstream OQ-2: prediction dated before the trial, falsifier tests before implementation, and a pre-ratified answer (D-3) if primitives fall short. Phase 3 drains the fork against harness-main history, deletes both dd trees, retires the verbs, lands the D-2 documentation riders, and closes the dogfood-findings ledger Jordan put in scope. Gates G1-G7 run inline; the whole-plan bar is plan validate --complete green plus the full suite on the final tree.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Every dd-side probe names the sha in the COMMAND and the finding (git show <sha>:<path>); never a bare-clone grep - dd main has DIVERGED from the work branch (three-seat trap, 2026-08-09)
- Never claim dd lacks an upstream fix without git merge-base --is-ancestor - that claim IS an ancestry assertion
- Pin by full 40-char sha; every re-pin re-runs the verify trio (pack shape, injection, A-2 tracked===null)
- npm git installs run with the sandbox disabled (git cannot write ~/.npm cache under it; the npm retry masks the cause)
- No shim for a missing SDK surface without telling dd first - a workaround is a finding that got absorbed (standing rule, both directions)
- harness commands run in-tree only: node harness/cli/bin/harness.js - no global link, no remap (Jordan)
- Nothing in services/dd or acts/dd is deleted until the AC-0006 drain checklist is green
- Dogfood findings go on the ledger the moment they bite (harness observe + ledger row), and the ledger closes to zero silent workarounds (Jordan scope ruling 2026-08-09)
- Phase-1 pin floor: the dep sha must be f712ded or later (type SchemaFs importable); annotate ports at declaration (const fs: SchemaFs = ...) so compile errors land at the write site
- Materiality threshold for remediation growth is DEFINED and falsifiable in assets/dogfood-ledger.md (4 conditions: outside touch set / >150 lines or new public surface / >3 fixes per phase / needs dd-side ratification) - defined 2026-08-09 before any contest
